VORELLIA / THE DETAILS

Accessibility

A site you can explore in the way that works for you.

Updated November 5, 2026

Features included

The site includes a skip-to-content link, semantic headings, visible keyboard focus, descriptive image text, responsive layouts and native disclosure controls. The scheduling dialog has a labeled calendar frame, a visible fallback link and can be closed with Escape.

Motion preferences

Animated sections include reduced-motion fallbacks. When your device or browser requests reduced motion, the site disables scroll zoom, entrance transitions and looping motion where practical. No audio plays automatically.

Keyboard and mobile use

Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move through controls, Enter or Space to activate controls and Escape to close an open dialog. Layouts are adapted for smaller screens rather than relying on desktop-only interactions.

Ongoing review

These features describe the current implementation and are not a claim of formal accessibility certification. Vorellia continues to review the site across browsers, devices and assistive technologies.

Report a barrier

If something makes the website difficult to use, email hello@vorellia.com with the page, device or browser, and the action you were trying to complete. Please do not include sensitive personal information.
